title: Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-template-publish: template-publish is failing in ultrastable/ultrastable
body:

**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/ultrastable template-publish
**Status:** closed
